protocol.memory_snapshot: one per run, created before retrieval
protocol.workspace_isolation: fresh workspace per run; checkpoint-pinned workspace on resume; reset before and after
protocol.checkpointing: append-only JSONL, idempotent per (task, baseline, seed)
protocol.note: Real configured chat model in a deterministic mock environment. Model performance is measured, not assumed.
